claim: Established specialist baselines adapted to common observations; not universal SOTA winners
implementation: waterbench/methods.py and waterbench/clustering.py; original project code and installed sklearn primitives
selection: Fixed before final test; strongest implemented specialist may be selected on validation only

residual-svm.adaptation: causal pressure residual features; no spectral clustering; sigmoid margin uncalibrated

lasso-direct.adaptation: point outputs; common 168 lags; no calendar or probabilistic simulator

forecast-ensemble.adaptation: reduced ensemble family; not competition solution reproduction

shape-msm-medoids.adaptation: exact enumeration of 220 medoid combinations instead of PAM heuristic
